pages.summary: Pansy y Hermione reconocen lo que sienten. Malcolm aligera el momento y las hace sentirse en familia.

panels.scene: Close Pansy in evergreen looking honestly across the dining table at Hermione, one hand resting on the oak. The warm lamp behind and side of the pram remain from previous page.
dialogue: Pansy: Ahora no puedo imaginar mi vida sin ti.

panels.scene: Pansy realizes what she said. She lowers her eyes, slightly flustered, and makes a small ordinary open-handed gesture. Jane and Malcolm listen kindly from across the table.
dialogue: Pansy: Quiero decir… como equipo, por supuesto.

panels.scene: Close two hands on the table. Hermione’s hand in gray cuff reaches over and gently holds Pansy’s hand with dark green cuff. Each person has one well-defined hand visible and fingers anatomically correct.
panels.caption: Hermione le tomó la mano.

panels.scene: Hermione smiles openly across the table. Brown eyes and freckles, both clothed and seated at a normal distance, sleeves and pendant visible.
dialogue: Hermione: Yo tampoco puedo imaginar mi vida sin ti.

panels.scene: Wider view. Jane smiles beside her glass, Malcolm sets down a fork then looks warmly at the two. Robin still sleeps safely in the Zephyr beside them.
dialogue: Malcolm: Menos mal que te gustan los automóviles. Parece que cenarás aquí a menudo.

panels.scene: Exterior wide view of the warm lit bay windows and evergreen wreath on the Granger house, seen quietly from the winter street. Exactly one house entrance, no people or extra lettering.
panels.caption: Tres días después, la Navidad ya estaba cerca.

pages.summary: Pansy descubre la cafetera de cápsulas y aprende a preparar el café de Hermione.

panels.scene: Jane demonstrates a small metallic coffee capsule beside the compact machine on the limestone countertop. Pansy watches carefully, hands down. Cups neatly stacked, no logos.
panels.caption: El primer descubrimiento de Pansy fue la cafetera.

panels.scene: Close espresso stream into one white cup, tendril of steam, no readable product labeling. Pansy’s observant green eyes above the machine in a separate plane.
panels.caption: Aquel ruido dejó de preocuparla cuando sintió el aroma.

panels.scene: Pansy studies a few differently sized white ceramic cups in a neat row, hand resting on the counter. Jane in sage cardigan lifts an eyebrow at the collection.
dialogue: Jane: Vas a empezar a escuchar colores si sigues bebiendo café.

panels.scene: Hermione enters through a wooden door in gray, hair loose. Pansy slides a single cream cup on its saucer toward her. Quiet warm kitchen light.
panels.caption: Cuando Hermione bajó, su taza ya la esperaba.

panels.scene: Hermione takes one gentle sip from the mug, then sets it down and looks at Pansy with a pleased soft smile.
Later morning insert. Two clean mugs side by side by the black machine on the same countertop, one sprig of pine beside a fruit bowl, visible winter sky.
panels.caption: Desde entonces, Jane dejó dos tazas junto a la cafetera.

pages.summary: El televisor fascina a Robin. Malcolm aprende quién decide qué se ve en la sala.

panels.scene: Malcolm presses a button on the remote from beside the olive sofa. Pansy in green looks at the television with a puzzled expression. Hermione in gray sits on the rug supporting Robin. Warm low fireplace in background.
panels.caption: El segundo descubrimiento fue el televisor.

panels.scene: The blue cartoon elephant appears on the TV. Robin, one small real-looking baby in lion-print pajamas, sits on the rug supported by Hermione’s hand at his waist. He waves one little hand.
panels.caption: Robin encontró su programa favorito.

panels.scene: On the same screen an ordinary suited weather presenter appears instead of the cartoon. Malcolm holds the one remote, looks toward Robin who frowns. Natural expression, no distress beyond a quivering lip.
dialogue: Malcolm: Solo quiero ver el pronóstico.

panels.scene: Same TV, blue elephant restored. Robin beams at the program from the same rug, Hermione at his side. Malcolm reluctantly smiles, lowers the remote.
dialogue: Jane: Sabe perfectamente quién tiene el control remoto.

panels.scene: Close Pansy beside the sofa, one wry amused smile. Green eyes, black bob, full knitted sweater. Robin’s brown curls and cream cuff at frame edge, safely supported.
Domestic wide shot near bay window later, warm books and folded blankets. Malcolm hums by the bookcase, Robin in Hermione’s arms, Jane and Pansy laugh on the sofa. No second baby and no extra toys.
panels.caption: Al día siguiente, Malcolm ya podía cantar la canción.

pages.summary: Jane sale a hacer las compras navideñas con Hermione, Pansy y Robin. Las puertas automáticas intrigan a Pansy.

panels.scene: View inside the warm hall beside the dark green front door and oak floor. Hermione points her wand safely at the lower brass frame of the Zephyr. Subtle gold glint only on the newly visible four small wheels. Robin sits snug in the stroller. Pansy watches in her gray hoodie, jeans and black boots. Put Pansy on the LEFT with the first balloon and Hermione on the RIGHT with the reply, both visible in the same established vestibule.
dialogue: Pansy: Esas ruedas arruinan el diseño.
Hermione: Evitan que alguien pregunte por qué flota.

panels.scene: Wide outside shot at a modern grocery storefront with glass sliding entrance, mild December decorations and no readable logo. Jane in camel holds a metal shopping cart. Hermione and Pansy arrive next to the one Zephyr. Both stroller and cart are distinct.
panels.caption: Jane quería hacer las últimas compras de Navidad.

panels.scene: The front glass doors glide apart on a floor track. Pansy stands just outside, looking up at the small sensor, both hands relaxed at her sides. Hermione and one Robin in the pram stay clear of the panels.
Close angle from the safe side of the open door. Hermione points to a small black sensor above the doorway. Robin peeks out of the cream hood with a happy open smile.
dialogue: Hermione: Tiene un sensor. Detecta cuando alguien se acerca.

panels.scene: Jane turns from inside by the neatly nested metal carts, smiling at Pansy. Orange and cream winter lights reflected in glass, no screen branding.
dialogue: Jane: Primero los alimentos. La electrónica puede esperar.

panels.scene: Wide aisle of winter vegetables in wooden bins. Jane pushes one cart, Hermione places a green vegetable inside, Pansy in charcoal hoodie walks beside Robin's pram and glances toward shelves of colorful boxes in the distance.

pages.transcript:
Capítulo 12 · 28

Jane sale a hacer las compras navideñas con Hermione, Pansy y Robin. Las puertas automáticas intrigan a Pansy.
Pansy: Esas ruedas arruinan el diseño.
Hermione: Evitan que alguien pregunte por qué flota.
Narración: Jane quería hacer las últimas compras de Navidad.
Pansy: ¿Cómo supo que estaba aquí?
Hermione: Tiene un sensor. Detecta cuando alguien se acerca.
Jane: Primero los alimentos. La electrónica puede esperar.
Pansy: No prometo nada.
pages.review: El cochecito conserva su estructura y añade ruedas visibles al salir. Pansy mantiene sudadera gris y bufanda verde, Hermione abrigo burdeos y Jane abrigo camel. Se revisaron las puertas, el sensor y el orden de diálogo.
